summary: Binary-level headless tasks: a real zenpi --mode headless process over JSONL stdio and the HTTP fake provider covers new file + bash output into the next request, approval denied (file never lands), cancel of a running command (killed within 10 s, never finishes), and SIGKILL mid-command then restart with -c (the resumed request carries the earlier prompt and a synthetic result for the killed call).
commands_run: cargo clippy --locked --all-features --test tasks_headless --test tui_task --test tasks -- -D warnings
notes: Each task writes ZENPI_HOME/config.toml pointing at the FakeServer chat endpoint; -c is exercised by the kill/restart task (cli_session also covers cwd scoping).
